title: Operation 40 becomes Operation Mongoose at JM WAVE

tellings.quote: converted operation 40 into operation mongoose. It's all it did. It set up the big operation on the uh Miami University of Miami campus called JM Wave.

plain: A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1960s, in the time of President Kennedy and Soviet leader Khrushchev, a secret anti-Castro group called Operation 40 was turned into Operation Mongoose, a covert US campaign against Cuba. He says it was run from a large operation called JM WAVE on the campus of the University of Miami. He tells it as background to his claim that Kennedy's death ties into the world of secret programmes, including UFO secrets.
